parent_objective: paired public natural-surface history-level advantage audit

public_gates: compute paired L3-L0 and L3-L2 deltas on matched source keys
report bootstrap or paired confidence intervals for success and clearance margin deltas
report M526 event-subset paired deltas separately
do not promote checkpoint or treat public rows as private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune checkpoints from M537 outcomes
do not collapse public diagnostic rows into private evidence
do not rank baselines using unmatched aggregate means only
hypothesis: The L3 advantage observed in M537 remains positive under paired source-key comparisons and is not dominated by one seed, one surface, or the M526 event subset.
success_criteria: paired source-key joins are valid for L0/L2/L3 comparisons
L3-L0 and L3-L2 margin deltas remain positive on aggregate
success and completion deltas are reported with paired uncertainty
surface and seed dominance are reported
M526 event rows are reported as public diagnostic overlays only
failure_criteria: paired joins are ambiguous or missing for a substantial fraction of rows
L3 advantage is dominated by a single surface or training seed
M526 event overlay is treated as private evidence

commands.name: paired_advantage_audit
commands.command: Aggregate M537 surface_outcomes.csv files by matched source keys and baseline seed; compute paired L3-L0 and L3-L2 deltas, dominance summaries, and public M526 event overlays.

decision_rule: M538 is a public diagnostic audit. If L3 advantage survives paired and dominance checks, it admits fresh holdout mining or longer matched training; it does not promote a checkpoint.
next_blocker: pending M538 paired public natural-surface audit
